text: As a full-time professional children’s entertainer and award-winning magician, I love amazing audiences, making children laugh and creating unforgettable memories.

From birthday parties, Communions and christenings to weddings, corporate events, Christmas parties and festivals, I bring every occasion to life with incredible magic, hilarious comedy, face painting, balloon modelling and lots of audience participation.
Happy children. Huge smiles. Magical memories!
